### 🌬️ The air is fresh. What about the integration?

Proxon FWT is a hobby project and stays free. You can help in three ways:

- ⭐ **Star it on GitHub**: it makes the project easier to find
- 🐞 **Report a bug or an idea**: as an [issue](https://github.com/bertel2020/HA-Proxon_FWT/issues/new)
- ☕ **Tip the air handler**: [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/bertel2020) · [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/bertel2020) · [PayPal](https://paypal.me/RobertoMartins)

### 🌬️ Die Luft ist frisch. Und die Integration?
